Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical genealogical error by incorrectly identifying the paternal grandfather of Germaine of Foix. In Step 3, the Planner concluded that the grandfather was "Gaston I de Foix-B arn" based on the search results for "Gaston II de Foix father of John of Foix". However, the search results explicitly stated that Gaston II (1308–1343) was the father of John of Foix (1450–1500), which is historically impossible due to the century gap. The search results also correctly identified that Gaston II's father was Gaston I (1287–1315), but the Planner failed to recognize that Gaston I was the *great-grandfather* of Germaine, not the grandfather. The correct paternal grandfather is Gaston IV of Foix-Grailly (father of John of Foix), not Gaston I. The Planner's error stemmed from a failure to verify the chronological consistency of the lineage chain and an incorrect assumption that the father of Gaston II (Gaston I) was the same generation as the father of John of Foix.
